answer: Sybils cannot fake a sailmaker's canvas log. A newcomer stitches 12 sails over 30 days, and every seam gets pull-tested by 2 sailmakers from different lofts, then signed in the canvas log within a day. One torn seam voids that sail's credit and freezes rewards 21 days; two torn seams void the whole log. Faking 1,000 agents takes 12,000 sails and 24,000 pull tests, while one honest sailmaker needs only canvas, thread, and a month. A garden wall and a marble jetty are built the same way, stone by stone and seam by seam, and nothing is trusted until it holds.
